sub_dimensions.name: Formatting

scoring_criteria.0: Raw block of unformatted text or keyword stuffing
scoring_criteria.5: Basic structure present with minimal formatting or clarity
scoring_criteria.10: Well-structured HTML with clear paragraphs, spacing, and scannability

sop_checklist: Description is written in HTML or properly formatted paragraphs (not raw/plain text)
Basic structure includes logical flow or sections (e.g., intro, benefits, usage)
No keyword stuffing, emojis, or non-compliant symbols used
edge_cases: Cap at 5 if content is fully plain-text even if readable
Cap at 6 if formatting exists but contains broken HTML or visual clutter

sub_dimensions.name: Brand Narrative

scoring_criteria.0: Generic or vague text with no persuasive benefit or brand tone
scoring_criteria.5: Some brand value and benefits communicated, but inconsistent or generic language
scoring_criteria.10: Persuasive, brand-aligned storytelling that highlights product USPs and customer value clearly

sop_checklist: Highlights unique selling propositions (materials, purpose, differentiators)
Persuasive content connects features to clear customer benefits (e.g., 'keeps food warm for hours')
Tone is consistent with brand and avoids vague, generic claims
edge_cases: Cap at 6 if it includes brand tone but no clear feature-benefit link
Cap at 5 if repeated bullet points or copied content is detected

Essential Fixes:
Structure the description using HTML tags (e.g.,
,

) or clear paragraph breaks for readability
Avoid use of raw blocks of text; separate product features, benefits, and usage into sections
Remove keyword stuffing, emojis, or prohibited phrases (e.g., 'best in class', '100% guarantee')
Conversion Boosters: Highlight key USPs (e.g., 'made of stainless steel', 'double-walled insulation') early in the text
Include practical use-case scenarios to help customers visualize value
Add 1–2 customer-centric lines about ease-of-use, care instructions, or compatibility (e.g., dishwasher safe, food-grade materials)
Premium Upgrades: Use persuasive storytelling to explain why this product fits the customer’s lifestyle
Reinforce differentiators like sustainability, compact design, or travel-friendliness (if applicable)
Use natural keywords like 'steel lunch box', 'airtight containers', 'bento-style design' to boost SEO without stuffing
Category-Specific: Kitchen: Mention materials (e.g., BPA-free plastic, stainless steel) and storage capacity
Home Decor: Describe design style (e.g., minimalist, rustic) and where it fits best (bedroom, kitchen, etc.)
Beauty: Mention skin type compatibility, application method, and benefits (e.g., hydration, anti-aging)
